prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1325; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened.

A: I was driving home from work and had just merged onto the main road. I needed to move into the left lane to get to my exit.

Q: Can you describe what you saw before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and saw a gray sedan a bit back, but it looked like it was far enough behind me. I signaled and started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: About halfway into the lane, I felt a hard bump on the passenger side. The other car had come up in my blind spot, and we scraped along each other before I could stop.

Q: Did you or the other driver brake or swerve?

A: I braked a little, and I think the other driver did too. We both pulled to the shoulder after that.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the side window when the impact happened. I felt dizzy and had a headache right away, and I had some trouble focusing on what people were saying at the scene.

Q: Have you been evaluated by a doctor since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that evening. They told me I have a concussion and I need to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Some. The headaches come and go, and I get tired faster than usual. My doctor has me on a lighter schedule at work.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.
